verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background. The MCP server and Ava are query-driven assistants, and Navan Edge explicitly requires confirmation before acting. Approval workflows, webhooks and API endpoints are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the autonomous automation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
